classes.name: agricultural resource
classes.label: agricultural resource
classes.definition: negotiable commodity that is obtained via some agricultural process, including forestry, fishing, livestock, grain, dairy, corn, cocoa, soybeans, sugar, coffee

classes.name: base metal
classes.label: base metal
classes.definition: common metal that tarnishes, oxidizes, or corrodes relatively quickly when exposed to air or moisture, that is widely used in commercial and industrial applications, such as construction and manufacturing

classes.name: basket of commodities
classes.label: basket of commodities
classes.definition: custom basket whose constituents consist of one or more negotiable commodities

classes.name: bullion
classes.label: bullion
classes.definition: physical precious metal that is officially recognized as being at least 99.5 percent pure

classes.name: commodity basket constituent
classes.label: commodity basket constituent
classes.definition: component of a custom commodity basket whose relative importance with respect to other basket constituents is known

rules.property: has commodity value as of date

classes.name: commodity derivative
classes.label: commodity derivative
classes.definition: derivative instrument whose primary underlying item is a physical commodity, or the price, or related index, or any other aspect related to a physical commodity

classes.name: commodity derivative underlier
classes.label: commodity derivative underlier
classes.definition: underlier of a commodity derivative, including, but not limited to, the negotiable commodity itself

rules.property: has commodity value as of date

classes.name: commodity forward
classes.label: commodity forward
classes.definition: forward contract in which a buyer and seller agree upon delivery of a specified quality and quantity of goods at a specified future date

classes.name: commodity future
classes.label: commodity future
classes.definition: futures contract to buy or sell a predetermined amount of a commodity at a specific price on a specific date in the future

classes.name: commodity index
classes.label: commodity index
classes.definition: investment vehicle that tracks a basket of commodities to measure their price and investment return performance

classes.name: commodity option
classes.label: commodity option
classes.definition: option where the option buyer has the right to buy or sell specified commodities or commodity related index at a fixed price or formula, on or before a specified date

classes.name: commodity return leg
classes.label: commodity return leg
classes.definition: leg of a commodity return swap in which the return is based on a physical commodity, or the price, or behavior of the price, or any other aspect related to a physical commodity

classes.name: commodity spot contract
classes.label: commodity spot contract
classes.definition: contract that involves physical delivery of the commodity asset at settlement

classes.name: commodity swap
classes.label: commodity swap
classes.definition: commodity derivative that includes, without limitation, any swap for which the primary underlying notional item is a physical commodity, or the price, or behavior of the price, or the level of a commodity index, or other aspect related to a physical commodity

classes.name: energy resource
classes.label: energy resource
classes.definition: negotiable commodity that is an energy-related product, or a derivative of an energy-related product, including electricity, renewable energy, or any power/energy delivered through a utility network of provider; diesel fuel, fuel oil, gas oil, gasoline, heating oil, jet fuel, kerosene, natural gas, oil (Brent, Tapis, Dubai, WTI)

classes.name: energy transmission rights
classes.label: energy transmission rights
classes.definition: rights to the transmission of power across an electricity distribution network

classes.name: environmental resource
classes.label: environmental resource
classes.definition: negotiable commodity including offset credits

classes.name: extraction resource
classes.label: extraction resource
classes.definition: negotiable commodity that is a mineral resource obtained via withdrawal from the natural environment

classes.name: fertilizer resource
classes.label: fertilizer resource
classes.definition: negotiable commodity that includes ammonia, diammonium phosphate (DAP), potash, sulphur, urea, urea and ammonium nitrate (UAN)

classes.name: freight resource
classes.label: freight resource
classes.definition: negotiable commodity that is a freight index route

classes.name: gas commodity
classes.label: gas commodity
classes.definition: extraction resource that is natural gas

classes.name: generated resource
classes.label: generated resource
classes.definition: negotiable commodity obtained via some generation process, including electricity, renewable energy, or any power/energy delivered through a utility network or provider

classes.name: grain commodity
classes.label: grain commodity
classes.definition: agricultural resource that is a small, hard seed, of a food plant, especially of a cereal plant, such as wheat, corn, rye, oats, rice, and millet

classes.name: industrial resource
classes.label: industrial resource
classes.definition: negotiable commodity that is obtained via some industrial process, including construction and manufacturing

classes.name: meat commodity
classes.label: meat commodity
classes.definition: agricultural resource derived from the flesh of an animal (especially a mammal), such as pork bellies

classes.name: metal
classes.label: metal
classes.definition: material that, when freshly prepared, polished, or fractured, shows a lustrous appearance, and conducts electricity and heat relatively well

classes.name: oil commodity
classes.label: oil commodity
classes.definition: generated resource that is a viscous liquid derived from petroleum, including for use as fuel, or as a lubricant, and the manufacture of many types of paints, plastics, and other materials

classes.name: oil grade
classes.label: oil grade
classes.definition: measure of the viscosity of oil during operation

classes.name: paper resource
classes.label: paper resource
classes.definition: negotiable commodity that is a paper product, including containerboard, newsprint, pulp, recovered paper

classes.name: polypropylene resource
classes.label: polypropylene resource
classes.definition: negotiable commodity including plastics

classes.name: service resource
classes.label: service resource
classes.definition: negotiable commodity involving services such as transportation, communications, and trade

classes.name: weather derivative
classes.label: weather derivative
classes.definition: derivative instrument whose primary underlying notional item is based on something related to the weather, for example, the average temperature in Chicago in January

edges.name: has commodity value as of date
edges.label: has commodity value as of date
edges.definition: indicates the per unit value of a given commodity as of some specified date

edges.name: has grade
edges.label: has grade
edges.definition: The grade of oil e.g. Brent Crude.
